workflow_rule: Obsolete racial typologies are historical classification material, not current biology. Scheduled Tribe status is state/UT-specific and must follow dated legal notification. Map labels do not prove legal status or exact boundaries.

evidence_holds: Obsolete physical racial typologies are rejected as current biological science.
State/UT Scheduled Tribe names and area qualifications require current legal notification.
The printed tribe map is a teaching map, not a statutory boundary map.
Undated rankings, old jurisdiction tables and ethnographic generalisations remain held.
